subject: RecipeFix /adapt result, phone viewport: Chicken Tikka Masala (RecipeFix Original), Dairy-Free, 4 -> 6 servings
what_is_real: All UI is the real RecipeFix web app at commit 8c44a5b4 (the tree production web serves), run locally with npx vite --mode production on 127.0.0.1:8531; no DOM injected or restyled.

The adaptation payload is the verbatim stored production adapt-recipe response captured 2026-10-21 (src/data/landingRealResult.ts), including the step notes, swaps, scaled amounts and nutrition shown.
The request the UI sent was produced by real taps on the landing composer: {mode: link, url: recipefix.app/original-recipes/chicken-tikka-masala, dietary: [Dairy-Free], servings: 6, stream: true}.
Video frames are Chromium's own compositor frames (CDP Page.startScreencast) at device pixels.
what_is_simulated: Backend transport: every *.supabase.co request is answered in-process by scripts/journey.mjs (auth guest, PostgREST, edge functions). Nothing reached Supabase or any model provider.
Auth: guest session; anon usage count is a local counter.

Stream timing: the SSE events are re-paced by the harness over ~4-5 s; the working card says 'Usually about 20 seconds' (true of production) but finishes in ~5 s here. Do not present the on-screen duration as real latency.
estimate-nutrition is aborted by the harness (the nutrition panel shows the payload's own estimate).
Pacing, holds and the eased scrolls are scripted (rAF window.scrollTo).

files: recipefix-adapt-phone.mp4 (H.264 High, yuv420p, 60 fps CFR, CRF 12)
video.source_frames: 804 variable-rate screencast frames resampled to exact 60 fps by timestamp (frame held until next)
video.why_not_playwright_recordVideo: recordVideo captured at CSS-px size (390x844) padded with grey inside a 780x1688 frame (and 500x757 with system Chrome's default window), ~0.7 Mbit/s VP8 - unusable. Replaced with CDP screencast in Chrome launched with --window-size=390,844 --force-device-scale-factor=2.

tomato_line_note: '1½ (14.5-oz) can crushed tomatoes' is on screen only while scrolling (~0.18 s and ~0.15 s, motion). It is never held. Measured per animation frame in-page.

changed_line_marking.steps: A rewritten step keeps its full instruction and gets a pale saffron box below it: info icon + 'RecipeFix changed this step' in rust bold, then the note text. No strike-through or diff of the step text. Summary line near top: 'What RecipeFix changed: 3 ingredients swapped, 15 amounts scaled from 4 to 6 servings, 5 steps rewritten'.
changed_line_marking.ingredients: Swapped lines are set in rust text with a 'Swapped' pill and a disclosure chevron (coconut yogurt, vegan butter, coconut cream; the coconut cream row also shows a Coconut cream / Soy cooking cream toggle). Scaled-only lines (e.g. 2¼ pounds chicken) carry no mark at all.
changed_line_marking.header: The header shows 'Dairy-Free' and a 'Serves [- 6 +]' stepper; it does not show '4 -> 6' itself - that appears only in the 'What RecipeFix changed' line.

console_errors_explained: All 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED': t~11.6 = harness abort of estimate-nutrition; t~25 = three publisher images (loveandlemons, recipetineats, cafedelites) for a lazily loaded section further down the page, blocked by the capture's external-request guard. That section is never scrolled into frame. No pageerrors.

network.supabase: all fulfilled/aborted in-process by Playwright route (never sent to network)
